scope: User-controlled fixed-scene demonstration; no learned policy or automatic task route

field_semantics.state_action_timing: row k measures s_k and controller reference for [k*dt,(k+1)*dt); terminal N has no action
field_semantics.joint_order: configs/config.json joint_order; first seven rad/rad_s, fingers m/m_s
field_semantics.tool_orientation: actual_quat_wxyz: unit quaternion, site frame in world
field_semantics.cube_orientation: cube_quat_wxyz: free-body unit quaternion in world
field_semantics.tool_velocity: actual_*_velocity_world_xyz: site origin linear m/s, angular rad/s, world axes
field_semantics.cube_velocity: cube_linear_velocity_world_xyz m/s; cube_angular_velocity_local_xyz rad/s in cube local axes
field_semantics.full_state: qpos includes free-body quaternion; qvel is generalized velocity and is not componentwise qpos derivative
field_semantics.input_events: events.jsonl: polled input transitions and discrete receive/process; received wall clock distinct from processing sim_s
field_semantics.actions: actions.jsonl: pre-request software context, requests/rejections and accepted segment intervals; repeated toggle intents resolve to explicit states; post-commit targets are not pre-action observations
field_semantics.planned_vs_executed: accepted end is planned exclusive endpoint; only 0..N-1 pre-step rows were executed
field_semantics.gripper_position: finger joint coordinate, not total jaw width

static_inspection.limitation: No manual contact motion or user acceptance has been run.

asset_location: Package assets; each file bound by assets/manifest.json
